Name: Henoch, Son of Midian
Summary: Son of Midian, named among the sons of Midian and grandsons of Keturah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 1:33: Son of Midian, named among the sons of Midian and grandsons of Keturah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Henoch stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
